name: @aico/agent
description: Aico's own agent harness: a thin loop on pi-agent-core with pi-ai providers and Pi's tools, role rules from @aico/context that fail closed, typed refusal and model-swap outcomes, in-conversation handoff, transcripts in agent.db.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --log-level=error --external:@earendil-works/* --outfile=dist/aico-agent.mjs --banner:js="// Aico agent bundle. Built by npm run build; do not edit.
import { createRequire as __aicoRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __aicoRequire(import.meta.url);"
